snippet.title: Neat Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tired of the mess? Molly's here to help.

Neat is a cozy organizer game where you transform cluttered spaces into satisfying order — one drawer, one shelf, one life at a time. Unpack, sort, and decorate your way through the unique locations, each hiding a story told entirely through the objects you find.

From a single mother's chaotic kitchen to places you'd never expect — every space has a history waiting to be uncovered.

Wishlist now on Steam!

#Neat #CozyGames #indiegame #OrganizingGame #CozyPuzzle
